questions.question:
12 is related to 4 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 24 is related to 8. To which of the following is 60 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is

12 is related to 4 → 12 ÷ 3 = 4

And,

24 is related to 8 → 24 ÷ 3 = 8

Similarly,

60 related→ 60 ÷ 3 = 20 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of I. Only two people sit between I and O. questions.solution:
Given: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north.

Thus, K sits at third position from the left end of the line.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All cows are emu.

All emus are ostrich.

Some ostriches are duck.

Conclusions:

(I) Some ducks are cows.

(II) All ostriches are cows.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb764ec14365c5a975c34194a3abef44b45c1dbc13d9ab2c844c47a477d99f73.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some ducks are cows → **Does not** follow (As all cows are emu, all emus are ostrich and some ostriches are duck. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) All ostriches are cows → Does not follow (As all cows are emu and all emus are ostrich. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
